mapper.select:
SELECT fin.finprod_id, fin.finprod_market_id shortName, fin.profit_type profitType, fin.term_days termDays, case fin.profit_type when '01' then finval.valuation else NULL end as netValue,
case fin.profit_type when '03' then finval.valuation else NULL end as fundIncome,
to_char(finval.val_date,'yyyyMMdd') as navDate, to_char(finval.val_date,'yyyyMMdd') as useDate, finval.total_value as totalNetValue, finval.year_yield as yearRate, finval.day7_year_yield as sevenYearRate,
case pafin.deal_mode when '01' then '10' when '02' then '20' when '03' then '30' when '04' then '30' when '05' then '41' when '06' then '40' when '07' then '40' when '08' then '40' when '09' then '50' else '10' end as prodType, bonusplan.UNIT_BONUS_VLU as divAmt, to_char(bonusplan.REG_DATE,'yyyyMMdd') as registerDate, to_char(bonusplan.BONUS_DATE,'yyyyMMdd') as dividendDate FROM fin_product_valuation finval left join fin_product fin on fin.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = finval.finprod_id and fin.FINPROD_TYPE2 = finval.FINPROD_TYPE2 left join pa_fin_product pafin on pafin.finprod_id = fin.finprod_id left join prd_bonus_plan_n bonusplan on finval.finprod_id = bonusplan.finprod_id and finval.val_date = bonusplan.DEL_DATE and bonusplan.BONU_SCALC_FLAG = #{bonusPlan,jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE finval.finprod_id = #{prodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND to_char(finval.val_date, 'yyyyMMdd') = #{sysDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
